biography_english: A Walister hailing from Golyat. His father, Prancet, was taken away by the Dark Knights when they attacked Golyat a year earlier. {hero} rallied to the cause of the Walister Resistance, harrying Bakram and Galgastani forces together with sister Catiua and friend Vyce.
biography_spanish: Walister de Golyat. Su padre, Prancet, fue capturado por los Caballeros Oscuros cuando atacaron Golyat hace doce meses. {hero} se unio a la Resistencia Walister, combatiendo a Bakram y Galgastan junto a su hermana Catiua y su amigo Vyce.

biography_english:
A Walister hailing from Golyat. His father, Prancet, was taken away by the Dark Knights when they attacked Golyat a year earlier. {hero} rallied to the cause of the Walister Resistance, harrying the enemies of his people together with sister Catiua and friend Vyce.
  Aided by a band of Xenobians he met in Golyat, he freed Walister leader Duke Ronwey from his imprisonment at Almorica Castle. He was then offered a place in the Walister Resistance, becoming captain of the Order of {order}.
  Called the Hero of Golyat by his people, he soon became a prominent figure in the Resistance.
biography_spanish:
Walister de Golyat. Su padre, Prancet, fue capturado por los Caballeros Oscuros cuando atacaron Golyat hace doce meses. {hero} se unio a la Resistencia Walister, combatiendo a Bakram y Galgastan junto a su hermana Catiua y su amigo Vyce.                            
  Con ayuda de xenobianos que conocio en Golyat, libero al lider Walister, el duque Ronwey, de su cautiverio en el castillo Almorica. Luego se unio a la Resistencia Walister como capitan de la Orden de {order}.               
  Llamado el Heroe de Golyat por su gente, pronto fue una figura clave en la Resistencia.

biography_english: A Walister hailing from Golyat who leads the Order of {order}. He joined the Walister Resistance after freeing Duke Ronwey from his imprisonment at Almorica Castle. He later broke his ties with them after opposing the duke's plan to unite the people by slaughtering Walister at Balmamusa. He is currently in hiding with his sister Catiua, awaiting an opportunity to overthrow the Duke.
biography_spanish: Walister de Golyat al frente de la Orden de {order}. Se unio a la Resistencia Walister tras liberar al duque Ronwey de su cautiverio en el castillo Almorica. Rompio lazos tras oponerse al plan del duque de unir al pueblo mediante la matanza de Walister en Balmamusa. Ahora se oculta con su hermana Catiua, esperando la oportunidad de derrocar al duque.

biography_english:
A member of the Walister Resistance hailing from Golyat. He joined the Resistance after freeing Duke Ronwey from his imprisonment at Almorica Castle. Together with Sir Leonar he took part in the killing of Walister civilians at Balmamusa, hoping to unite his people against the enemy. For his loyalty he was made a senior officer of the Resistance.
  The enemy call him the "Butcher of Golyat," and he is hunted by those who know the truth behind the massacre at Balmamusa.
biography_spanish:
Miembro de la Resistencia Walister oriundo de Golyat. Se unio a la Resistencia tras liberar al duque Ronwey de su cautiverio en el castillo Almorica. Junto a sir Leonar participo en la matanza de civiles Walister en Balmamusa para unir a su pueblo contra el enemigo. Por su lealtad fue nombrado oficial superior de la Resistencia.                 
  El enemigo lo llama "Carnicero de Golyat", y lo persiguen quienes conocen la verdad tras la matanza en Balmamusa.

biography_english:
A member of the Walister Resistance hailing from Golyat. He joined the Resistance after freeing Duke Ronwey from his imprisonment at Almorica Castle, but left for a time due to their involvement in the massacre at Balmamusa.
  He went into hiding with sister Catiua, but eventually rejoined the Resistance when Sir Leonar appealed to him for aid following the Bakram invasion of Rhime. He now continues to battle the Bakram, seeking to drive them from Walister lands.
biography_spanish:
Miembro de la Resistencia Walister de Golyat. Se unio a la Resistencia tras liberar al duque Ronwey de su cautiverio en el castillo Almorica, pero se alejo un tiempo por su participacion en la matanza de Balmamusa.          
  Se oculto con su hermana Catiua, pero regreso a la Resistencia cuando sir Leonar le pidio ayuda tras la invasion bakram a Rhime. Sigue combatiendo a Bakram para expulsarlos de tierras walister.

biography_english:
A Walister hailing from Golyat who leads the Order of {order}. He joined the Resistance after freeing Duke Ronwey from his imprisonment at Almorica Castle. Due to the massacre at Balmamusa he broke his ties with the Resistance and went into hiding with Catiua.
  In battle with Sir Leonar he learned the Duke planned to forge a secret treaty with the Dark Knights Loslorien. He set off for Rhime to stop the proceedings, but before he could act the duke was killed through Vyce's treachery. With the Resistance rudderless he offered to take the helm, and he now commands all of southern Valeria.
biography_spanish:
Walister oriundo de Golyat que lidera la Orden de {order}. Se unio a la Resistencia tras liberar al duque Ronwey del castillo Almorica. Debido a la matanza de Balmamusa rompio lazos con la Resistencia y se escondio con Catiua.                                 .
  Tras luchar con sir Leonar descubrio que el duque planeaba un tratado secreto con los Caballeros Oscuros de Loslorien. Partio hacia Rhime para detenerlo, pero antes de actuar el duque murio tras la traicion de Vyce. Sin lider en la Resistencia, tomo el mando y ahora lidera todo el sur de Valeria.

biography_english:
A Walister hailing from Golyat who leads the Order of {order}. He joined the Resistance after freeing Duke Ronwey from his imprisonment at Almorica Castle, and later took part in the massacre at Balmamusa.
  Upon ousting Sir Leonar, who had slain the Duke over doubts about his fitness to lead, he took control of the Resistance. He also made peace with Vyce's New Walister Alliance, demonstrating a caliber of leadership beyond his years.
biography_spanish:
Walister de Golyat al mando de la Orden de {order}. Se unio a la Resistencia tras liberar al duque Ronwey del castillo Almorica y luego participo en la matanza de Balmamusa.                                
  Al derrocar a sir Leonar, quien mato al duque al dudar de su capacidad de liderazgo, asumio el mando de la Resistencia. Hizo la paz con la Nueva Alianza Walister de Vyce, mostrando una gran madurez para liderar a su edad.

biography_english:
A Walister hailing from Golyat who leads the Order of {order}. He joined the Resistance after freeing Duke Ronwey from his imprisonment at Almorica Castle, and later took part in the massacre at Balmamusa. Despite setbacks he eventually came to lead the Resistance against the Bakram and Dark Knight forces.
  His people call him the "Hero of Golyat," and have faith that he can put an end to the ravages of war.
biography_spanish:
Walister oriundo de Golyat que lidera la Orden de {order}. Se unio a la Resistencia tras liberar al duque Ronwey del castillo Almorica y luego participo en la matanza de Balmamusa. Pese a los contratiempos, asumio el mando de la Resistencia contra las tropas de Bakram y los Caballeros Oscuros.             
  Su pueblo lo llama "Heroe de Golyat" y confia en que acabe con los estragos de la guerra.

biography_english:
A Bakram hailing from Golyat who leads the Order of {order}. He joined the Resistance after freeing Duke Ronwey from his imprisonment at Almorica Castle, and later took part in the massacre at Balmamusa. Despite setbacks he eventually came to lead the Resistance against the Bakram and Dark Knight forces.
  He was reunited with his father, Prancet, at Brigantys Castle, and from him learned the truth of Catiua's past. Olivya also revealed he was actually born in Heim of Bakram descent, with his father the brother of Regent Brantyn Morne. He now seeks to destroy the Dark Knights to fulfill his father's dying wish.
biography_spanish:
Bakram oriundo de Golyat que lidera la Orden de {order}. Se unio a la Resistencia tras liberar al duque Ronwey del castillo Almorica y luego participo en la matanza de Balmamusa. Pese a los contratiempos, asumio el mando de la Resistencia contra las tropas de Bakram y los Caballeros Oscuros.             
  Tras hallarse con su padre, Prancet, en el castillo Brigantys, supo la verdad de Catiua. Olivya le revelo que nacio en Heim y es de origen bakram, pues su padre era hermano del regente Brantyn Morne. Hoy combate a los Caballeros Oscuros para cumplir el ultimo deseo de su padre.

biography_english:
A Bakram hailing from Golyat who leads the Order of {order}. He joined the Resistance after freeing Duke Ronwey from his imprisonment at Almorica Castle, and later took part in the massacre at Balmamusa. Despite setbacks he eventually came to lead the Resistance against the Bakram and Dark Knight forces.
  He was reunited with his father, Prancet, at Brigantys Castle, and from him learned the truth of Catiua's past. Olivya also revealed he was actually born in Heim of Bakram descent, with his father the brother of Regent Brantyn Morne. He fulfilled his father's dying wish and led the Resistance to victory against the Dark Knights, defeating them in a bloody battle.
biography_spanish:
Bakram oriundo de Golyat que lidera la Orden de {order}. Se unio a la Resistencia tras liberar al duque Ronwey del castillo Almorica y luego participo en la matanza de Balmamusa. Pese a los contratiempos, asumio el mando de la Resistencia contra las tropas de Bakram y los Caballeros Oscuros.             
  Tras hallarse con su padre, Prancet, en el castillo Brigantys, supo la verdad del pasado de Catiua. Olivya le revelo que nacio en Heim y es de linaje bakram, siendo su padre hermano del regente Brantyn Morne. Cumplio el ultimo deseo de su padre y lidero a la Resistencia hasta vencer a los Caballeros Oscuros en una sangrienta batalla.

biography_english:
A Walister hailing from Golyat who grew up with {hero}. His father was slain a year ago when the Dark Knights Loslorien attacked Golyat. With his mother already dead, he was left an orphan.
  He came to deeply resent the Bakram and Galgastani for their oppression of the Walister, and resolved to fight for his people's freedom.
biography_spanish:
Walister oriundo de Golyat que crecio junto a {hero}. Su padre murio hace doce meses al atacar Golyat los Caballeros Oscuros Loslorien. Sin madre, quedo huerfano.                           
  Guardo gran rencor a Bakram y Galgastani por oprimir a los walister, y decidio luchar por la libertad de su gente.

biography_english:
A Walister hailing from Golyat who grew up with {hero}. He was formerly the leader of the New Walister Alliance.
  Together with {hero} he rescued Duke Ronwey and joined the Walister Resistance. He later broke his ties with the Resistance after strongly opposing the massacre of innocent Walister at Balmamusa. He went on to form the New Walister Alliance to champion Walister self-rule and break the nobility's grip on power, earning much favor from his people.
  He eventually reconciled with the Resistance when {hero} took up its leadership. His might in arms served the Order of {order} well, helping bring the war to an end.
biography_spanish:
Walister oriundo de Golyat que crecio junto a {hero}. Fue el lider de la Nueva Alianza Walister.                
  Junto con {hero} libero al duque Ronwey y se unio a la Resistencia Walister. Rompio lazos con la Resistencia al oponerse con firmeza a la matanza de walister inocentes en Balmamusa. Luego fundo la Nueva Alianza Walister para buscar la autogestion walister y arrebatar el poder a la nobleza, ganandose el favor del pueblo.                          
  Al final se reconcilio con la Resistencia cuando {hero} tomo el mando. Su fuerza sirvio a la Orden de {order}, ayudando a poner fin a la guerra.

biography_english:
A Walister hailing from Golyat who grew up with {hero}. Together they rescued Duke Ronwey and joined the Walister Resistance. He took part in the massacre of innocent Walister at Balmamusa despite {hero}'s opposition, creating a rift between them.
  The Duke rewarded his loyalty by appointing him the leader of the Resistance's Third Spear.
biography_spanish:
Walister de Golyat que se crio con {hero}. Juntos liberaron al duque Ronwey y se unieron a la Resistencia Walister. Participo en la matanza de walister inocentes en Balmamusa pese a la oposicion de {hero}, lo que creo una brecha entre ambos.      
  El duque premio su lealtad al nombrarlo lider de la Tercera Lanza de la Resistencia.

biography_english:
A Walister hailing from Golyat who grew up with {hero}. Together they rescued Duke Ronwey and joined the Walister Resistance. He took part in the massacre of innocent Walister at Balmamusa despite {hero}'s opposition, creating a rift between them.
  The Duke rewarded his loyalty by appointing him the leader of the Resistance's Third Spear. He was ordered to do away with those who know the truth of Balmamusa, and he now seeks to kill {hero}.
biography_spanish:
Walister de Golyat que se crio con {hero}. Juntos liberaron al duque Ronwey y se unieron a la Resistencia Walister. Participo en la matanza de walister inocentes en Balmamusa pese a la oposicion de {hero}, lo que creo una brecha entre ambos.      
  El duque premio su lealtad al nombrarlo lider de la Tercera Lanza de la Resistencia. Le ordenaron eliminar a quien supiera la verdad de Balmamusa, y hoy busca matar a {hero}.

A Walister hailing from Golyat who grew up with {hero}. Together they rescued Duke Ronwey and joined the Walister Resistance.
  He later broke his ties with the Resistance after strongly opposing the massacre of innocent Walister at Balmamusa. His whereabouts are currently unknown.

Walister oriundo de Golyat que crecio junto a {hero}. Rescataron al duque Ronwey y se unieron a la Resistencia Walister.

He went on to form the New Walister Alliance to champion Walister self-rule and break the nobility's grip on power, earning much favor from his people.

  Falsely accused by the Resistance of plotting to kill Duke Ronwey, a hefty bounty of 50,000 goth has been placed on his head.
biography_spanish:
Walister de Golyat que se crio con {hero}. Juntos liberaron al duque Ronwey y se unieron a la Resistencia Walister, donde comando la Tercera Lanza.                   
  Participo en la matanza de Balmamusa y fue nombrado lider de la guardia personal del duque. Sin embargo, al no aceptar la reincorporacion de {hero} a la Resistencia, huyo.                  
  Acusado falsamente por la Resistencia de planear matar al duque Ronwey, ofrecen 50.000 goth por su cabeza.

biography_english:
A Walister hailing from Golyat who grew up with {hero}. Together they rescued Duke Ronwey and joined the Walister Resistance, where he once commanded the Third Spear.
  He took part in the massacre at Balmamusa and was made leader of the Duke's personal guard. However, unable to come to terms with {hero}'s reinstatement into the Resistance, he took flight.
  With an unprecedented sum of 60,000 goth on his head, he is pursued by the Resistance and headhunters alike.
biography_spanish:
Walister de Golyat que se crio con {hero}. Juntos liberaron al duque Ronwey y se unieron a la Resistencia Walister, donde comando la Tercera Lanza.

  Con una cifra sin precedentes de 60.000 goth por su cabeza, lo persiguen la Resistencia y cazarrecompensas.

biography_english:
A Walister hailing from Golyat who grew up with {hero}. Together they rescued Duke Ronwey and joined the Walister Resistance, where he once commanded the Third Spear.
  He took part in the massacre at Balmamusa and was made leader of the Duke's personal guard. However, unable to come to terms with {hero}'s reinstatement into the Resistance, he took flight.
  Realizing he had been used, he stole in and slew the Duke while Resistance forces were engaged in the retaking of Rhime. He then met his end at the hands of Resistance soldiers.
biography_spanish:
Walister de Golyat que se crio con {hero}. Juntos liberaron al duque Ronwey y se unieron a la Resistencia Walister, donde comando la Tercera Lanza.                   
  Participo en la matanza de Balmamusa y fue nombrado lider de la guardia personal del duque. Sin embargo, al no aceptar el regreso de {hero} a la Resistencia, huyo.                          
  Al ver que lo habian usado, entro a hurtadillas y mato al duque mientras la Resistencia reconquistaba Rhime. Luego hallo su fin a manos de soldados de la Resistencia.

biography_english:
A Walister hailing from Golyat who grew up with {hero}. Together they rescued Duke Ronwey and joined the Walister Resistance, where he once commanded the Third Spear.
  He later took part in the massacre of Walister at Balmamusa despite {hero}'s opposition, creating a rift between them. His loyalty to the Resistance was rewarded through his promotion to leader of a force reporting directly to the Duke.
  However, his lust for power led him to conspire with the Bakram and slay the Duke. He also plotted to kill the Dark Knight Lanselot, but failed in his attempt. The Bakram laid sole blame on him, and he was executed for his crime.
biography_spanish:
Walister de Golyat que se crio con {hero}. Juntos liberaron al duque Ronwey y se unieron a la Resistencia Walister, donde comando la Tercera Lanza.                   
  Mas tarde participo en la matanza de walister en Balmamusa a pesar de la oposicion de {hero}, lo que creo una brecha entre ambos. Su lealtad a la Resistencia fue premiada con su ascenso a lider de una fuerza a las ordenes del duque.    
  Pero su sed de poder lo llevo a conspirar con los bakram y matar al duque. Tambien planeo matar al caballero oscuro Lanselot, pero fracaso en su intento. Los bakram le echaron toda la culpa y fue ejecutado por su crimen.

He went on to form the New Walister Alliance to champion Walister self-rule and break the nobility's grip on power, earning much favor from his people.
  He eventually reconciled with the Resistance when {hero} took up its leadership. His might in arms serves the Order of {order} well as they strive to put an end to the war.

Fundo la Nueva Alianza Walister para lograr la autogestion walister y acabar con el poder de la nobleza, ganandose el favor de su gente.                              
  Al final se reconcilio con la Resistencia cuando {hero} asumio el mando. Su fuerza en combate sirve bien a la Orden de {order} mientras luchan por poner fin a la guerra.

He continued to serve the Resistance thereafter, commanding a force reporting directly to the Duke. However, his lust for power led him to conspire with the Bakram and make an attempt on the lives of the Duke and the Dark Knight Lanselot. He was hanged by the Bakram after the plot failed.
  Following his death he was reanimated by the Necromancer Nybeth, but then defeated by {hero}, finally putting his tormented soul to rest.

biography_english:
A Walister hailing from Golyat. She is sister to {hero}. After the Dark Knights attacked her hometown of Golyat, she joined {hero} and Vyce in striking back at their oppressors.
  As Catiua's mother died when she was young, she assumed the maternal role in the family. Her father, Prancet, has trained her in the ways of the sibyl.
biography_spanish:
Walister de Golyat. Es hermana de {hero}. Tras el ataque de los caballeros oscuros a su ciudad natal de Golyat, se unio a {hero} y Vyce para luchar contra sus opresores.        
  Como la madre de Catiua murio cuando era joven, asumio el rol materno en la familia. Su padre, Prancet, la instruyo en las artes de la sibila.

biography_english:
Catiua's true name is Versalia Oberyth. She is sister to {hero}. After the Dark Knights attacked her hometown of Golyat, she joined {hero} in striking back at their oppressors.
  She went into hiding after opposing the massacre at Balmamusa, but returned to the Resistance fold after the Bakram invasion of Rhime.
  Believing {hero} to be her only true kin, she became distraught at the distance that had grown between them, and decided to leave the Resistance. Upon her return to Golyat, the Dark Knight Lanselot informed her she was the daughter of the Dynast-King and the Queen's handmaiden Mannaflora. Her current whereabouts are not known.
biography_spanish:
El verdadero nombre de Catiua es Versalia Oberyth. Es hermana de {hero}. Tras el ataque de los caballeros oscuros a Golyat, se unio a {hero} para luchar contra sus opresores.  
  Se escondio tras oponerse a la matanza de Balmamusa, pero regreso a la Resistencia tras la invasion bakram de Rhime.                  
  Creyendo que {hero} era su unico pariente real, se afligio por la distancia entre ambos y decidio dejar la Resistencia. Tras volver a Golyat, el caballero oscuro Lanselot le informo que era hija del rey dinasta y de Mannaflora, sirvienta de la reina. Se desconoce su paradero actual.
